doc.md:
Describes how [`LevelBar`](xref:gtk:LevelBar) contents should be rendered.

Note that this enumeration could be extended with additional modes
in the future.

continuous.brief: the bar has a continuous mode
continuous.md: the bar has a continuous mode

discrete.brief: the bar has a discrete mode
discrete.md: the bar has a discrete mode
